Description: Collect StateFlow in composables with lifecycle awareness
Screens receive state and callbacks; ViewModels own logic
Don't: Business logic or IO inside composables

Description: Expose data classes / immutable lists so Compose can skip recomposition
Don't: MutableList or var fields in state

Description: LazyColumn items need stable keys for correct animations and state
Use LazyColumn for anything that can grow
Mixed headers and rows benefit from contentType
Don't: Ignoring heterogeneous rows in huge lists

Description: Use MaterialTheme.colorScheme roles; brand values live in ui/theme
Provide light and dark schemes; avoid pure black
Use MaterialTheme.typography styles and sp units
Single-line titles must ellipsize
Icon-only actions need contentDescription for TalkBack
Purely decorative images use null description
Do: AsyncImage(cover, contentDescription = null) next to a title
Don't: Describing decorative art with redundant text

Description: Minimum 48dp interactive size and 8dp spacing
Layouts must survive font_scale 1.3-2.0
Every visible string in strings.xml, EN + ES
Use placeholders, not concatenation
Determinate progress when size is known, indeterminate otherwise
Show readable errors near the action, offer retry
Empty screens explain what to do next
3-5 destinations; preserve tab state with rememberSaveable
Don't: More than 5 tabs or hamburger for primary nav
Code Bad: var tab by remember { ... } (lost on rotation)

Description: System back must never trap the user
Do: BackHandler only for in-screen state (clear search)
Don't: Overriding back to exit flows silently

Description: App draws behind system bars; Scaffold insets padding
Load covers with Coil, fixed size and crop, placeholder icon underneath
Do: AsyncImage(url, null, contentScale = Crop, modifier = size(52.dp))

Description: 150-300ms, animate*AsState / AnimatedVisibility, graphicsLayer for transforms
Material Icons Rounded (AutoMirrored for directional)
Never block the UI thread; engine calls are suspend
Debounce search-as-you-type
